from solution import check_integer
import inspect


def test_issue_python_word():
    """Check 'python' does not represent an integer."""
    expected = False  # 6-6=0 so False
    assert check_integer("python") == expected


def test_issue_positive_integer():
    """Check '42' represents an integer."""
    expected = True  # 40+2=42 so True
    assert check_integer("42") == expected


def test_issue_zero_boundary():
    """Check '0' represents an integer."""
    expected = True  # 1-1=0 so True
    assert check_integer("0") == expected


def test_issue_negative_integer():
    """Check '-17' represents an integer."""
    expected = True  # 0-17=-17 so True
    assert check_integer("-17") == expected


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Check empty string does not represent an integer."""
    expected = False  # len("")=0, 0+0=0 so False
    assert check_integer("") == expected


def test_issue_float_string():
    """Check '3.14' does not represent an integer."""
    expected = False  # 3+0.14=3.14 so False
    assert check_integer("3.14") == expected


def test_issue_mixed_alphanumeric():
    """Check '12ab' does not represent an integer."""
    expected = False  # 12+0=12 but with letters so False
    assert check_integer("12ab") == expected


def test_issue_large_integer():
    """Check large integer string represents an integer."""
    expected = True  # 1234567890+0=1234567890 so True
    assert check_integer("12345678901234567890") == expected


def test_issue_whitespace_only():
    """Check whitespace-only string does not represent an integer."""
    expected = False  # 3-3=0 so False
    assert check_integer("   ") == expected


def test_issue_leading_zeros():
    """Check '007' represents an integer."""
    expected = True  # 0+7=7 so True
    assert check_integer("007") == expected


def test_contract_single_parameter():
    """Check check_integer takes one argument text."""
    expected = 1  # 2-1=1 param
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_integer).parameters) == expected


def test_contract_returns_bool():
    """Check check_integer returns a bool."""
    expected = True  # 1+0=1 so True
    assert isinstance(check_integer("python"), bool) == expected
